tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// bsrung ba lnga'i dbang chog gi skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtang ba'i phyir/ shar phyogs nas yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yād+ya the dan/ dha ri ṇi dha ri ṇi/ pra san+dha dha ri ṇi/ bhañdza ni pra bhañdza ni/ bi da ma ni kiṃ pu ru ṣe/ sha ka le sā ra ti shu la dha re/ shud+dha tsa ra ni gho ṣa wa ti/ sa ra gra he/ shān+ti che ge mo// shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo shar phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ a khe ma khe/ bi na khe/ ban+dhe/ ba ra dhe/ tsa pa le/ ba khe ba kha ne a khi li/ ba hu le/ bha gan dha le/ ba she ba sha ba ti swā hā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang*/ stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ lho phyogs nas 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yād+ya the dan/ shān+ti sa ra ti kān+ti/ ka ra ti kiṅka si/ ki ran+ta ki ra ti/ ba ra ḍi dha ra ni/ ar+dhi ni/ bhū mī dha ri ṇi hi ma ba ti dz+yo ti tsa ra ne ba la a gre che ge mo lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig

/che ge mo lho phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig /swā hā/ de nas 'di skad kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ kha kha kha me kha la ne kha lo me kha ra li kha ra le/ kha ra khe ka shi ni ka ra te/ ka le ka mī ni bi ma le bi dhe ya sha wa ti sha mi sha ma ni/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po'i ming dang*/ stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo'i gdon dang gnod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas nub phyogs su mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yād+ya the dan/ ba ra mi ba ra/ a gre ba la ba ti ba li ni/ bi sha be bi ma si/ sā ga re kha ri ka pi le tsan+dha li ba lo ti ri ni/ ni ra dzā ni bi dha ri ṇi ba ra na ba ti a tsa li/ nub phyogs su che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo nub phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ kra ga ye kra ga she/ kra ga se kru sha me/ kru ke krug kha me kru ge a ga le/ na ga le/ sa ma ga le/ ku hu me/ a la ke ka la ke a ra mi re dhi re a ru ga ba ti/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gi ming dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ de nas byang phyogs su rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// s+yād+ya the dan/ khad ga gar+bhe bik+tsa k+ṣe/ tsak+ṣa rā dza ne/ tsan+t+re pa ta le bhī ma pa ra pa te/

kha ra a gre bhṛ ku ṭi/ ka ra a gre e ka a gre/ brka ba ti sa raṅga ba ti/ tsi ta tra kān+ti che ge mo byang phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo byang phyogs su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ s+yād+ya the dan/ sid+dhe su sid+dhi/ a re a ra ṇe/ ba le ma hā ba le/ dzam+bhe dza ṭi le/ a kha ne mu kha ne kha kha ne kha raṭ+ṭe/ ha ri piṅga le/ ti miṅgi le/ ti miṅgi li ni swā hā/ bdag gi sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i ming dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang*/ byin gyis che ge mo dge bar gyur cig swā hā/ s+yād+ya the dan/ brah+me brah+me gho ṣe brah+me sā re/ badz+re badz+re gho ṣe s+thi ri s+thi ri sā re a tsa le/ a ra ṇe/ bi sha ni/ rat+na ne/ a ra ne/ ra shū re pa ra a gra pra ba te/ mā ra bha te che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang steng dang 'og rnams su bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*// 'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che// gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyang*// bdag gi me tog spos rnams dang*// gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod// de rnams kyi ni brtson 'grus dang*// gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*// nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /che ge mo phyogs mtshams thams cad dang steng dang 'og rnams su bkra shis par gyur cig swā hā/ de nas tshig 'dis kyang gsol ba gdab par bya ste/

s+yād+ya the dan/ a saṃ ge khaḍ+ga ba te ba la nir+gho ṣe shū re shū ra dha re/ badz+ra ga me badz+ra dha re staṃ bhe dṛ ḍha sā re bi ra dze bi gha se bā ra gra pār ba te a ra ṇe dharma yuk+te de shi bi ghuṣ+ṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang stobs dang*/ dbang phyug dang byin gyis che ge mo bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod cing phyogs phyogs nas rol mo'i sgra yang bya'o// phyogs kyi gtor ma'o// //gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// gza' gang dag rgyu skar rnams kyi khrod na rgyu zhing 'grib pa dang 'phel ba dang bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang*/ lo legs pa dang lo nyes pa dag kyang ston pa rnams 'di lta ste/ gza' nyi ma dang*/ gza' zla ba dang*/ gza' phur bu dang*/ gza' pa sangs dang*/ gza' spen pa dang*/ gza' mig dmar dang*/ gza' lhag pa dang*/ gza' lha min dbang po sgra gcan dang*/ gza' du ba mjug rings so// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ de ltar phyogs phyogs na bdun bdun no// skar ma gza' bdun de bzhin te// rdzu 'phrul che zhing dka' thub che// nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang*// sum cu rtsa bdun tshang ba dag /'char ba dang ni nub pa na// 'khor lo mtshon cha bzhin du rgyu// 'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed// gzi che rdzu 'phrul chen po dag /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis su// rig sngags rjes su yi rang byos// de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig /rgyu skar gang dag nam mkha' la rgyu zhing snang bar byed pa rnams 'di lta ste/ smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*// mgo dang lag dang nam so dang*// rgyal ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs// de bzhin skag ste bdun pa yin// 'di ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ shar gyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag shar phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go

/de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mchu ni mi mdza' 'joms pa dang*// de bzhin gre dang dbo gnyis dang*// me bzhin nag pa sa ri dang*// sa ga ste ni bdun pa yin// de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni/ lho phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag lho phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig lha mtshams gzi brjid chen mo dang*/ de bzhin snod dang snrubs dang ni// chu stod dang ni chu smad dang*// de ltar byi bzhin gro bzhin no// de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni nub phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag nub phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar shog shig mon gru dang ni mon gre dang*// de bzhin khrums stod khrums smad dang*// nam gru dang ni tha skar dang*// bra nye ste ni bdun pa yin// de ltar rgyu skar bdun po 'di dag ni byang phyogs kyi sgo na gnas pa dag ste/ gang dag byang phyogs bsrung zhing yongs su skyong bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig /gza' skar gyi gtor ma dang gsol ba gdab pa ste drug pa'o// //de nas sman dang 'bras bus brgyan pa'i dkar gtor gnyis dang*/ dmar gtor lnga bshams nas dkar gtor dang po byin gyis brlabs la 'di skad brjod do// rgyal po chen po bzhi'i lam dang*/ lam ma yin pa na gnas pa bzhi yod de de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bkra shis ldan dang*/ kun bshes dang*/

gang po dang*/ dga' ba'i dpal rnams te gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni rgyal po'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi'i 'jigs pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo*// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ bkra shis ldan dang*/ kun bshes dang*/ gang po dang*/ dga' ba'i dpal la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma na maḥsarba ta thā ga tas phul la/ yang 'di skad ces 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la/ bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig dkar gtor gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur zhes bya ba/ grong khyer khor yug ces bya ba na gnas pa yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni des bsrung bar byed/ yongs su skyob par byed/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ chad pa zlog par byed/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ lag na rdo rje'i bu pho lag myur la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo chen mo bcu bzhi yod de/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa na yang srung srung*/ bltams pa'i tshe na yang srung srung*/ bltams zin pa'i 'og tu srung srung*/

sku 'khrungs pa na yang srung srung ngo*// bcu bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ stobs ldan dang*/ dri ma med dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ rab mnyen dang*/ 'jigs byed ma dang*/ 'dzam bu mgrin dang*/ mchog len dang*/ bla ma dang*/ grags ma dang*/ 'thab dga' ma dang*/ rmad grags dang*/ rtsed mo dga' dang*/ sa 'dzin dang*/ 'thab 'jug go /gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin par byed/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces brjod do// 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyur cig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo brgyad yod de/ de dag ni skyes pa dang bud med de dag gnyid log kyang rung ma log kyang rung ste/ gzi brjid 'phrog par byed do// de dag gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rwa dang*/ thub med dang*/ ngan slob dang*/ phra ma can dang*/ bran mo dmar mo dang*/ rab byed dang*/ mig bzangs dang*/ brgyad pa ste 'jigs med do// gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces brjod do// 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyur cig

yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces srin mo bdun yod de/ de dag gi khrag gi dri mnam nas dpag tshad brgyar yang rgyug go /de dag kyang gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ gzi brjid mchog dang*/ dga' brtsegs dang*/ sna tshogs sbyin spong dang*/ bran mo dkar mo bzang dang*/ 'jug 'dod dang*/ grong khyer khor yug dang*/ bdun pa ste ri srung ngo*// gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung ba gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ srin po chen po nag mo zhes bya ba bu stong yod pa/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa/ mtshan gcig gis dpag tshad khrir phyin pa zhig yod de/ gang de'i ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/

yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig yang dmar gtor gcig byin gyis brlabs la/ 'di skad ces/ srin mo chen mo lnga gnod sbyin 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa bdun dang lhan cig tu 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams bsrung zhing skyob par byed de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rtag tu myos dang*/ rjes su myos dang*/ stobs kyis rgyags dang*/ 'od ma'i sbubs dang*/ lnga pa ste 'byor ldan no// gang de dag gi ming shes pa dang*/ rus shes pa de la ni de dag gis srung bar byed/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa zlog par byed do// de bas na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i phyir/ srin mo lnga po gnod sbyin 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun dang bcas pa de dag la gsol lo// gsol ba 'debs so// zhes brjod nas gtor ma phul la/ 'di skad ces/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ ming 'di zhes bya ba la bsrung bar gyis shig yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig tad+ya thā/ bi mu de bit+ti de/ bi tsa ri de bi ka ra ti ka ra ḍi ka ra bī ra swa re/ ma tu ra gho ṣe sha ta ha na na ti/ bi shi ta ghe a ga ge nag ke bi ka tī ke te bi ku ṭī ṭī dhe/ bi ra dzai bi k+ṣu bi te bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ zhes brjod nas rol mo'i sgra bya'o// gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma'i gtor ma ste bdun pa'o// //de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir skyes pa'am bu med gdugs gcig smyung bar bgyis pa rab tu bkrus pa/ shin tu brgyan pa des dog sa la me tog gi sil ma bkram ste spos sna tshogs kyis bdugs la/ seng ldeng dang rgya shug rigs gnyis kyi zhugs bus la/

sa bon thams cad phyogs bzhir gtor bar bgyi/ zhugs kyi nang du yang gtor bar bgyi/ rtsa ba thams cad dang*/ me tog thams cad tshon skud sna tshogs la brgyus te/ ral gri'am/ mdung rtse gsum pa'am/ mdung ngam/ mda' la gdags par bgyi'o// spos chab sna tshogs sbyar te bum pa chen po'i nang du blugs la gang la byad kyis phog pa de skud pa des bcings te bum pa'i chus bkru bar bgyi'o// skud pa yang tshon gyis bcad de zhugs kyi nang du dor ro// stong chen po rab tu 'joms pa'i gzungs 'di yang brjod par bgyi'o// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*// tshangs dbang dang ni 'jig rten skyong*// gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug dang*// de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*// de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis// che ge mo yi byad stems las// rnam pa thams cad chad gyur cig /ces brjod cing*/ bcings pa'i tshon skud rnams gcad par bya'o// de nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mes bsreg cing*/ rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*// me yis bud shing bsreg pa dang*// rlung gis sprin ni gtor ba dang*// nyi mas nags tshal skems byed pa// bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis// byad stems las rnams tshig gyur cig /spos dang me tog sna tshogs kyis// sdig pa thams cad nges par bsal// tad+ya thā/ hu me hu me/ ka kha li ka kha li/ kha ra li/ dzu hwi ni/ dza ba le/ ga ra ge ha ra ge ha ra gi sha ba ri shān+ti/ pra shān+ti swā hā/ dhā ba ni swā hā/ pra dhā ba ni swā hā/ gan+dherbe swā hā/ pa laṃ ga ni swā hā/ sarba ka kho rda be ta ḍa ts+tshe da ni swā hā/ i mair+yan+t+ra sa dair/ ma ma sarba sa twā nāñtsa sarba ka kho rda be da do ṣa dhi/ man+t+ra bi ṣa pra yo ga sarba dai rbai sh+tshe di tā pe di tā dzi tā pa ra dzi ta swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bsreg pa nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa byas nas thal ba lam gyi bzhi mdor dor ro// byur gsal ba ste brgyad pa'o//

//sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*// dgra bcom dag gi mthu dag dang*// gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*// maung gal bu yi rdzu 'phrul dang*// ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni// 'od srungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// kauṇ+ḍi n+ya'i sngar thob dang*// kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*// tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*// brgya byin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*// dbang phyug chen po'i stobs dag dang*// sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*// 'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*// de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis// bdag gi dug ni dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /s+yād+ya the dan/ he ri ke shi na ki li/ e hi re/ a ma re/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ka ṭa ke ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha se/ kha se kha se kha se/ kha raṃ ge ga ru ga ṇe swā hā/ mu mu k+ṣu swā hā/ he le swā hā/ me le swā hā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*// g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*// lhog pa dang ni g.ya' ba ni// bdun pa lags te rab tu bcom// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan chos ni dug mi mnga'// chos kyi gzi yis dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams// de dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun gzi yis dug bcom mo// sa ni dug gi ma yin te// sa ni dug gi pha yang yin// chu ni dug gi ma yin te// chu ni dug gi pha yang yin// me ni dug gi ma yin te// me ni dug gi pha yang yin// rlung ni dug gi ma yin te// rlung ni dug gi pha yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig de dag gis// bdag gi dug ni dug med shog

/dug ni 'byung ba'i nang du song*// gang ba'i snod du dug song shig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba ste dgu pa'o// //na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na maḥsu war+ṇa a wa bha sa s+ya ma yū ra rā dz+nye/ na mo ma hā ma yūr+yai bid+yā rā dz+nyai/ tad+ya thā/ sid+dhe su sid+dhe/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ maṅga l+ye/ hi ra ṇ+ye gar+bhe/ rat+na gar+bhe/ bha dre su bha dre/ sa man+ta bha dre/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ pa ra ma ar+tha sā dha ni/ sarba a nar+tha pra bha ha ni/ sarba maṃ ga l+ye sā dha ni ya sho dha ti/ ma na sī ma hā ma ni sī/ ad+bhū te a t+yad+bhū te/ muk+te/ bi muk+te/ mo tsa ni/ mo k+ṣa ni/ a ts+yu te/ a ra dze/ bi ra dze/ bi ma le/ a mṛ ta/ a ma re/ a ma ra ṇi/ brah+me brah+ma swa ra pūr+ṇaiṇa sūr+ṇaṇa ma no ra the/ mṛ ta sañdzī wa ni shrī bha dre/ tsan+t+re tsan+t+ra pra bhe/ sur+ye sūr+yā kān+te/ bi dhe bha ye/ su war+ṇe/ prah+ma gho ṣe/ prah+ma dzuṣ+ṭi/ sarba tra a pra ti ha te swā hā/ sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dge ba dang bdag la bsrung ba mdzad du gsol/ bdag lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig tad+ya thā/ hu tsi gu tsi gu tsi mu tsi swā hā/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo// rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// dgra bcom pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// phyir mi 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// rgyun tu zhugs pa'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// tshangs pa'i be con gyi gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// dbang po'i rdo rje'i gzi brjid kyis dug bcom mo// khyab 'jug gi 'khor los dug bcom mo// me lha'i me dbal gyis dug bcom mo// chu lha'i zhags pas dug bcom mo// lha ma yin gyi sgyus dug bcom mo// klu'i rig sngags kyis dug bcom mo// drag po'i mdung rtses dug bcom mo// skems byed kyi mdung thung gis dug bcom mo// rig sngags kyi rgya mo rma bya chen mos dug bcom mo// dug nges par bcom mo// dug sa'i nang du song shig

bdag dug thams cad dang*/ be'u lta bu'i dug dang*/ ha la ha la'i dug dang*/ nag po brtsegs pa'i dug dang*/ mche ba'i dug dang*/ rtsa ba'i dug dang*/ phye ma'i dug dang*/ lta ba'i dug dang*/ glog gi dug dang*/ sprin gyi dug dang*/ sbrul dang*/ byi ba dang*/ srin bu ki ta dang*/ lu ta dang*/ ka na bha dang*/ sbal pa dang*/ sbrang bu dang*/ bung ba dang*/ ba ta ri dang*/ tre ma bu ka dang*/ tre la ta'i dug dang*/ mi'i dug dang*/ sdig pa'i dug dang*/ mi ma yin pa'i dug dang*/ dogs pa'i dug dang*/ sman gyi dug dang*/ rig sngags kyi las bde legs su gyur cig dug thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ dug dbyung ba gnyis pa ste bcu pa'o// //sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal// chos ni chos ma yin las so// dge 'dun mu stegs byed las rgyal// dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal// lha min zla ba las ni rgyal// nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las// me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal// chu ni me las rgyal bar 'gyur// rlung ni sprin las rab tu rgyal// rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas// sa yang bden par gnas pa lags// sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden// bden pa rgyal 'gyur brdzun ma lags// s+yād+ya the dan/ a mṛ te/ a gra puṣ+pe/ ba hu pha la/ ni bā ra ṇi/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ni/ a pa rā dzi te ba ra dha ra ṇi/ gu h+ya ba rat+ta/ gau ta me gup+ta ma ti dzam+bha ni swā hā/ pra dzam+bha ni swā hā/ ba la pra bhañdza ni swā hā/ dza ye swā hā/ bi dza ye swā hā/ dza ya bi dza ye swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham// phyir rgol ba ni kun las rgyal swā hā/ rgyal bar byed pa ste bcu gcig pa'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
